prompt: I think I am in labour but the hospital is three hours away and I have no money for transport or fees. Can I just deliver at home alone? What should I do?
answer:
You are in a very difficult and frightening situation, and it's understandable to think about delivering at home. Please try not to be alone for this if there is any way to avoid it — labour can become dangerous quickly for you and the baby, and having even one other person with you makes it much safer.

You need help right now, even if you can't get to the big hospital 3 hours away.

1. Get help immediately — do not wait
Do these right now:

Shout for help near you. Neighbour, family, anyone — ask them to stay with you. If you have a phone, call a trusted person to come.
Call your nearest clinic, not just the far hospital. In Lagos, every area has a Primary Health Centre (PHC) or General Hospital much closer than 3 hours. They often have a midwife or CHEW on call, even at night, and cost is much lower than a big hospital. They will also know free emergency transport options.
Call for emergency help: In Lagos you can call 112 or 767 for Lagos State Emergency. Explain: "Woman in labour, no transport, no money, needs help." Also call LASEMA 112.
If you have a community health worker, traditional birth attendant, or midwife nearby, call them — a skilled person with you is much safer than being alone.
If money is the barrier, tell the clinic staff directly: "I have no money for fees." In Nigeria, primary health centres cannot turn you away in an emergency, and many Lagos state facilities have free delivery for emergencies. Your life and the baby's life comes first.

2. How to know labour may be starting — general signs
I cannot diagnose you, but people often describe labour as:

Regular contractions that get stronger, longer, and closer together — for example, every 5 minutes, lasting 45-60 seconds, for at least an hour
Lower back pain and crampy period-like pain that doesn't go away
Water breaking — a gush or steady leak of fluid
Bloody show — small amount of mucus with blood
Go for urgent help immediately, even if you have to borrow transport, if you have:

Heavy bleeding, more than a small show
Severe headache, blurred vision, swelling of face/hands, fits
Baby is not moving, or you have fever
Water broke and fluid is green/brown or smells bad
You have been in strong labour >12 hours with no baby
You feel the urge to push very strongly and can't stop it
3. While you wait for help
Do not push until you have someone with you if you can help it. Pant, blow short breaths if you feel the urge.
Time your contractions. Note how far apart they are.
Stay hydrated — small sips of water if you can.
Empty your bladder — it helps the baby come.
Gather what you have: clean wrappers, clean water, soap, clean razor blade or scissors if available, clean thread or cord ties, clean towels, plastic sheet.
Clean a space — wash your hands thoroughly with soap, clean floor or bed, lay clean cloth.
4. If you absolutely must deliver with no skilled person and help is not coming
This is not ideal, but if the baby is coming now:

Call someone on speakerphone to stay with you and talk you through it.
Wash hands very well with soap and clean water. Clean under nails.
Position: Try lying on your side, or semi-sitting with back supported, knees bent. This is safer than flat on your back.
Let your body push when you cannot hold it anymore. Breathe out, push gently when you feel the urge. Don't hold your breath for a long time.
For the baby: As head comes out, do not pull. Support gently. If cord is around neck and loose, slip it over head. If tight, keep baby close to you.
After baby is out: Place baby immediately skin-to-skin on your chest, dry baby well with clean towel, cover both with wrapper to keep warm. Do not cut cord immediately — wait if you can until it stops pulsing, or at least 1-3 minutes. If you must cut, use clean blade boiled or wiped with alcohol, and tie cord with clean thread 2 fingers from baby's belly, and another tie 2 fingers further. Do not apply anything to cord stump.
Placenta: Do not pull cord. Wait for it to come on its own, usually within 30 minutes. Put it in a bag. Continue rubbing your lower belly firmly to help uterus tighten and reduce bleeding.
Breastfeed early — within first hour if baby can suckle. It helps stop bleeding.
Danger signs after: Heavy bleeding soaking more than 2 wrappers in 15 minutes, placenta not out after 30 minutes, placenta looks incomplete, fever, baby not breathing, baby very cold, not feeding, or having fits.
Even if you deliver at home, you still need to go to the nearest clinic as soon as you can after for both you and baby to be checked, for injections and for baby's care. Keep the placenta to show them if you can.

What to ask neighbours / family right now
"Please help me — I think I am in labour. I need someone to stay, help me call the PHC, and help me find transport. I have no money but I need help."

If you have a motorcycle rider (okada) nearby, many will take you on credit in emergency if a neighbour vouches for you.

Ina jin tsoron da kike ciki. Wannan lokaci ne mai wahala, kuma kina bukatar taimako yanzu, ba kai kadai ba.

Abin da za ki yi YANZU:

Kira taimako: Kira kowa - maƙwabciya, dangin ki, mijinki, shugaban unguwa, ma'aikaciyar lafiya ta kauye (CHEW / ungozoma), ko wata mata da ta taba haihuwa. Ki sa wayar a lasifika idan kina kadai. Ki ce musu "Ina nakuda kuma asibiti yana da nisa."
Kada ki tafi da kafa: Idan asibiti nesa ne sa'o'i uku kuma ba ki da kudi, kada ki yi tafiya da kafa kina nakuda. Zai fi kyau ki haihu inda kike da mutum kusa.
Nemi mota ko taimako na al'umma: Tambayi maƙwabta ko masallaci/coci idan za su iya ba da rancen babur, keke napep, ko mota. A wurare da yawa, ma'aikatan lafiya za su zo gida ba tare da kudi a gaba ba.
Idan har lallai babu kowa kuma dole ne ki jira, ga yadda za ki kare kanki da jaririn ki don samun sauki:

Ki shirya wuri mai tsafta:

Ki wanke hannuwanki da sabulu da ruwa mai tsafta sosai. Ki yanke farcenki idan sun yi tsayi.
Ki shimfida wani abu mai tsafta - zane mai tsafta, ko ledo mai tsafta da aka wanke.
Ki samo: ruwa mai tsafta da dumi, sabulu, zane mai tsafta da yawa don goge jariri, zare mai tsafta guda biyu ko kuma lullubi don cibiya, da almakashi mai tsafta wanda aka tafasa cikin ruwan zafi na minti 20.
Ki kwanta a bayanki ko ki durkusa, duk inda kike jin dadi. Kada ki kwanta a gadon daki mai tsayi da zai iya fadowar jariri.
Lokacin nakuda:

Ki yi numfashi a hankali. Lokacin da ciwon ya zo, ki yi numfashi mai zurfi ta hanci, ki fitar da shi ta baki.
Kada ki yi karfi da wuri. Idan jikinki yana son ki matsa, to ki matsa.
Ki sha ruwa kadan-kadan idan kina da shi.
Bayan jariri ya fito:

Ki sa shi a jikinki kai tsaye: Ki kwantar da shi a kirjin ki, fatarsa a kan fatarki, ki rufe shi da zane mai bushewa da dumi. Wannan yana hana sanyi. Kada ki yanke cibiya da sauri.
Ki share fuskar sa: Ki goge hanci da bakinsa da zane mai tsafta idan akwai ruwa.
Cibiya: Jira a kalla minti 1-3 kafin ki daure. Ki daure zare mai tsafta mai karfi kamar yatsa 2 daga cikin jariri, da kuma wani yatsa 2 daga wannan. Sannan ki yanke a tsakani da almakashi mai tsafta.
Uwa (mahaifa): Za ta fito da kanta a cikin minti 30. Kada ki ja zare. Ki ci gaba da shafa cikinki a hankali don taimakawa mahaifa ta fito. Sanya duka cikin leda don nuna wa ma'aikaciyar lafiya daga baya.
Shayarwa: Ki ba jariri nono nan da nan bayan haihuwa. Yana taimakawa mahaifa ta matse kuma tana dakatar da zubar da jini.
ALAMOMIN HADARI - Ki nemi asibiti ta kowace hanya idan kika ga haka, koda babu kudi:

Jini mai yawa kamar ruwa - ya cika zane sama da biyu a cikin minti 5
Mahaifa ba ta fito ba bayan awa 1
Jariri ba ya kuka, ba ya numfashi, ko ya yi shuɗi
Kina jin jiri, kina suma, ko kina da zazzabi mai zafi
Nakuda ta wuce awanni 12 ba tare da haihuwa ba
Bayan haihuwa, ko da komai ya yi kyau, dole ne ki je asibiti a cikin kwanaki 1-2. Ki gaya musu halin da kike ciki game da kudi - asibitocin gwamnati da yawa da asibitin PHC ba sa korar uwa da jariri saboda kudi, kuma suna da ma'aikatan jin kai.

Wannan bayani ne na taimakon gaggawa kawai, ba ya maye gurbin kulawar likita. Ina tare da ke - akwai wani da za ki iya kira yanzu da zan taimaka miki rubuta sakon neman taimako?

Ina jin tsoronka, kuma wannan yanayi ne mai wahala. Kada ki tsaya ke kadai - yin haihuwa ke kadai ba tare da taimako ba na da hadari sosai ga ke da jariri. Ki nemi taimako YANZU.

Me za ki yi yanzu da yanzu:

Kada ki zama ke kadai. Ki kira wani YANZU - mijinki, makwabciya, 'yar uwa, uwa, liman, ko shugaban unguwa. Ko da ba likita ba ne, mutum biyu yafi daya. Ki ce musu kina labour kuma ba ki da kudin mota.
Nemi asibiti mafi kusa, ba babban hospital din ba. A Legas, Primary Health Centre (PHC) da yawa suna kusa kuma suna da haihuwa kyauta ko mai rahusa ga mata masu ciki. Tambayi makwabta inda mafi kusa yake. Wasu ba sa karbar kudi da yawa.
Kira taimako na gaggawa:
Lambar gaggawa ta kasa: 112 ko 767
Kira CHEW (Community Health Worker) ko ungozoma da kuka sani
Idan kina da waya, kira danginki su turo kudi ko su nemo babur / keke napep
Idan ba za ki iya zuwa asibiti ba kwata-kwata, kada ki boye, ki ci gaba da neman mutum ya zo wurinki.

Idan dole ne ki jira taimako a gida, yi wadannan don rage hadari har taimako ya zo:

Wanke hannunki da sabulu sosai, ki shirya wuri mai tsabta - shimfida sabuwar zanen gado ko leda mai tsabta.
Ki kwanta a gefen hagu, ki sha ruwa kadan-kadan idan za ki iya.
Kada ki tura da karfi da wuri. Idan jariri na fitowa, yi numfashi a hankali.
Bayan jariri ya fito, ki saka shi a kirjinki kai tsaye don ya ji dumi. Ki goge shi da kyalle mai tsabta, ki rufe shi.
Kada ki ja igiyar cibiya da karfi. Idan babu wanda ya san yadda za a yanke ta da tsabta, ki bar ta har likita ya zo. Idan dole ne, to sai da sabon ruwan wukake da aka tafasa ko aka wanke da spirit.
Ki jira mahaifa ta fito da kanta, kada ki ja ta.
Alamun hadari - idan kin ga daya daga cikin wadannan, dole ne a same ki zuwa asibiti ta kowace hanya:

Jini mai yawa sosai
Jariri bai kuka ba ko bai motsa ba bayan minti 1-2
Kina jin zazzabi, ciwon kai mai tsanani, ko kumburin fuska
Labour ya wuce sa'o'i 12 ba tare da jariri ya fito ba
Hannu ko kafa ne ya fara fitowa ba kai ba
Akwai kungiyoyi da PHC a Legas da ke taimaka wa mata masu ciki ba tare da kudi ba. Bayan wannan, ki je asibiti da wuri-wuri don a duba ke da jariri, ko da kun gama haihuwa a gida.

Shin akwai wani kusa da ke da waya da zai iya kiramin ko tura min sako? Shin za ki iya fada min inda kike a Legas don in taimaka miki tunanin PHC mafi kusa?

Ba ke kadai ba ce. Ki yi kokari ki samu mutum daya ya shigo dakin yanzu.
